A man identified simply as Abiodun has died by suicide in the Idimu area of Lagos State, following an alleged disagreement with his lover over their relationship. PUNCH Metro learnt on Wednesday that the incident occurred in the Ire Akari area of the community on Saturday after his longtime girlfriend reportedly told him she was no longer interested in continuing their relationship. It was gathered that Abiodun, said to be in his early 30s, was arguing with the yet-to-be-identified woman when she announced her decision to end the relationship. Disturbed by the development, he reportedly drank the contents of an insecticide he was holding in his hand. A resident of the area, who pleaded anonymity and spoke to PUNCH Metro on Wednesday, said Abiodun was rushed to a hospital on Powerline Road, where he later died. Make PUNCH part of your everyday experience. Add us to your Preferred Sources “He was having issues with his girlfriend, and it later resulted in an argument on Saturday evening. She eventually told him that she was no longer interested in the relationship and stepped out of the house. By the time she returned, Abiodun had already consumed insecticide. He was rushed to a hospital on Powerline Road, where he later died,” the resident said. The source added that Abiodun’s mother was immediately alerted and made efforts to secure medical attention for him. “His mother works at a supermarket in the area and tried all she could to ensure that he was revived. She was alerted by neighbours who had already rushed him to the hospital. She thereafter tried to raise money to pay for the required medical expenses. The resident added that Abiodun had since been buried on Monday. PUNCH Metro further learnt that the whereabouts of his girlfriend had remained unknown since the incident. When contacted, the Lagos State Police Public Relations Officer, Abimbola Adebisi, said she was unaware of the incident. She promised to revert after obtaining details of the incident but had yet to do so as of press time.
